findings.summary: Duplicate channel changes create duplicate active policy rows
findings.details: buildBulkPolicyPlan does not reject duplicate channelKey entries inside one bulk request. The loop processes each duplicate independently, and nextEpoch/next deliveryGeneration read only pre-request existing policies, so duplicate entries for the same channel compute the same new epoch/generation and are both returned active. channelPolicies.impl then inserts every planned routing and delivery row active, violating immutable active-pointer uniqueness and all-or-nothing policy semantics. Rework must add typed PolicyInvalid duplicate-channel-key rejection before planning/writes and a focused backend regression test proving duplicate channelKey requests fail.
evidence: packages/convex/confect/slack/channelPolicy.ts:197-282 iterates request.changes without checking for duplicate change.channelKey values and computes nextEpoch/next deliveryGeneration from request.existingRoutingPolicies/request.existingDeliveryPolicies only.

packages/convex/confect/slack/channelPolicies.impl.ts:121-144 inserts each planned routingPolicy and deliveryPolicy active after deactivating only pre-existing active rows, so duplicate planned rows remain active.
packages/convex/test/channel-policies.test.ts:140-217 covers missing channel partial bulk rejection but has no duplicate-channel-key request coverage.
